description: Execute SDK TypeScript against a session as one undoable commit — the write path AND every structured read. Source arrives as `code` (a string) or `path` (a file); what it MEANS is decided by the code itself. No default export = a SNIPPET: the run context (`wb`, `log`, `warn`, `error`, `args`) is ambient, async is implicit (never write `await`), and the final expression is the result. A default export = a SCRIPT handed that context; its return value is the result. RETURNING A SUBJECT DESCRIBES IT: `{ code: "wb" }` renders the workbook report, `wb.getWorksheet('Sales').getRegions()` maps the uniform blocks, `wb.getRange('Sales!B2:D9').getStats()` the numbers — ask for the answer, not the cells. There is no query tool: every structured question is one line of `run`. Returns status "ok", "compile_error" (fix the source, call again), "runtime_error", or "drift" (the session changed since `original_commit_id` — re-read and retry). On success use `commitId` with `session_revert`.

args.description: Arguments exposed to the run as `args` — the parity of the CLI's trailing `-- <args…>`. Parameterize a reused script instead of editing its source.

code.description: TypeScript source, as a string — the form for code you wrote this turn (never write a scratch file just to have a path).

description.description: Short label for the change (shown as the undo entry).

md.description: Options for the RENDERED report, not for the query — the parity of the CLI's `--md.<key>=<value>`. `{ features: "fill,borders" }` narrows a workbook or sheet report to those feature partitions; `{ mode: "value" }` reads cells at full precision with formatting stripped. Reach for it when a report is a haystack rather than an answer. There is no option for a LONGER report: every listing that truncates names the query that returns the rest. An unknown key is an error and names the whole vocabulary.

original_commit_id.description: Drift guard: if the session head differs from this, the write is rejected with status "drift".

path.description: Path to a script file with a life beyond this turn: repo-checked-in, reused, or user-reviewed. Absolute or workspace-relative. Pass exactly one of `code`/`path`.

session_id.description: Target session id, from `info` or `list_sessions`. Required.

name: run
